hook: Rural Telangana tops India: *95.3%* of homes cook on LPG
hook_b: Rural Telangana tops India: *95.3%* of homes cook on LPG
tldr: An SBI Research analysis of NSO's 2023-24 household spending survey puts Telangana's overall LPG use at 84.4%.

beats.what: Rural Telangana is ahead of Andhra Pradesh (86.9%), Punjab (84.1%) and Karnataka (81.5%).
beats.why: Distributors credit state and central schemes plus CSR drives over 10-15 years.
beats.care: It is a measure of clean cooking fuel reach; some states are far behind, like Chhattisgarh at 15.3% rural.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana has about 1.3 crore active LPG consumers; around 40 lakh got access through state schemes, the distributors' association says.

cards.q: Why do fewer city homes use LPG here?

qs: Does urban use count piped natural gas separately?

facts.t: The analysis covered *2,61,953* households surveyed between Aug 2023 and July 2024.

viz.verdict: Rural homes ahead of urban, unusual among states

watch: Whether urban numbers rise as piped gas and newer surveys come in.

sources.name: Times of India
sources.title: Rural Telangana leads India in LPG usage 95.3% households rely on it: report

fact: Rural Telangana leads India with *95.3%* of homes cooking on LPG
twist: Villages beat cities here: urban Telangana's LPG use is only *73%*.
